d:
Pesh hai film aamadni athanni kharcha rupaiya ka behad khubsurat aur sadabhar gana "aaee hai divali suno ji gharvali", jise apni madhur aavaz men udit narayan, alka yagnik, kumar sanu, shan, ketki dave, aur sneha pant ne sajaya hai.
film: aamadni athanni kharcha rupaiya (2001)
gayak: udit narayan, alka yagnik, kumar sanu, shan, ketki dave, sneha pant
git: aaee hai divali suno ji gharvali
Agar aapko purane hindi filmi git aur sadabhar nagme pasand hain, to is khubsurat git ko zarur sunen aur apne priyajnon ke sath sheyar karen.
